message: Here are 9 construction hazards I identified from the image

hazards.title: Unprotected trench without shoring
hazards.description: Two workers are inside a deep, narrow trench with near-vertical unsupported walls and no visible trench box, shoring, sloping or benching, creating a serious cave-in risk.

hazards.title: Spoil pile at trench edge
hazards.description: A large pile of excavated soil and rocks on the right side sits directly at the trench lip, adding surcharge load to the wall and risking material rolling onto the workers below.

hazards.title: Workers at unprotected trench edge
hazards.description: Workers on the left stand at the loose, unbarricaded trench edge, including one lowering a pipe into the trench, risking a fall into the excavation or collapse of the edge beneath them.

hazards.title: Excavator operating near trench
hazards.description: An excavator at the upper right is positioned beside the spoil pile near the trench while workers are in the excavation, posing struck-by and wall-collapse risks.

hazards.title: No visible trench access ladder
hazards.description: No ladder or ramp is visible in the trench near the workers inside, limiting safe entry and emergency egress.

hazards.title: No barricades along trench
hazards.description: The long open trench has no visible barricades, warning tape or barriers along its edges despite workers and equipment operating in the surrounding area.

hazards.title: Pipe lowered toward trench workers
hazards.description: A worker standing at the trench edge in the center of the image is lowering a long pipe by hand into the trench where other workers are working, creating a struck-by risk if it slips or drops.

hazards.title: Stacked pipes with minimal restraint
hazards.description: A stack of large gray pipes on the left, a short distance from the trench, is held by only a single wooden upright, posing a risk of pipes rolling off the stack.

hazards.title: Loose debris and rubble at edge
hazards.description: Loose gravel and rocks along the left trench edge create tripping hazards and could be dislodged onto workers in the trench.
